settings.name: Ayesha Siddiqua (Lahore)
settings.title: Cutest accent table ever!
settings.content: This hourglass table is so chic! Placed it right next to my reading chair in the bedroom. It easily holds my mug, lamp, and books. The cinched waist design is so stylish.

settings.name: Zubair Hashmi (Karachi)
settings.title: Top value at Rs. 6,000
settings.content: At 6,000 PKR, this is a steal! Genuine heavy marble top and the pedestal base has zero wobble. Arrived securely packed to Clifton Karachi in 3 days.

settings.name: Mariam Sohail (Islamabad)
settings.title: Architectural hourglass shape
settings.content: Looks like an expensive designer side table from an upscale boutique. The gold wireframe finish is warm and lustrous. Love it!

settings.name: Farhan Akhtar (Rawalpindi)
settings.title: Very sturdy and compact
settings.content: Small footprint makes it ideal for tight spaces. Solid build quality and beautiful marble top. Highly recommend.

settings.name: Sadia Munir (Faisalabad)
settings.title: Flawless finish
settings.content: Everything from the smooth edge on the marble to the sturdy flared base is flawless. Ordered a second one for my sister!

settings.name: Usman Ghani (Peshawar)
settings.title: Very happy with Gull e Gulzar
settings.content: Gull e Gulzar never compromises on finishing. Great communication via WhatsApp and smooth delivery.

settings.name: Fatima Zahra (Multan)
settings.title: Perfect sofa side companion
settings.content: Fits right beside our couch armrest. Looks very luxurious with the marble top reflecting the room light.
